name: Disgust
when: Messy data · broken query or bad input

variants.name: Ew
variants.desc: Squeezes its eyes shut and recoils from a green whiff.

variants.name: Gag
variants.desc: Eyes scrunched, it heaves twice with queasy green cheeks.

variants.name: Eye roll
variants.desc: Lidded side-eye, then a slow, deliberate roll of the eyes.

variants.name: Shudder
variants.desc: A full-body shudder, eyes clenched, with shiver lines.

variants.name: Nope
variants.desc: Turns its back on you, peeks once, and turns away again.

parts.t: <g class="cheeks"><ellipse cx="{{a.ck1}}" cy="{{a.cky}}" rx="6" ry="3.4"></ellipse><ellipse cx="{{a.ck2}}" cy="{{a.cky}}" rx="6" ry="3.4"></ellipse></g>

<g class="eg eg-chev" stroke="{{a.eye}}"><g transform="translate({{a.lex}} {{a.ley}})"><path class="gl" d="M-4 -4.5L3 0L-4 4.5"></path></g><g transform="translate({{a.rex}} {{a.rey}})"><path class="gl" d="M4 -4.5L-3 0L4 4.5"></path></g></g>

<g class="fx-shiver" transform="translate(0 {{a.mo}})"><path class="a sv svl thin" d="M10 38Q7 44 10 50M5 42Q2 47 5 52"></path><path class="a sv svr thin" d="M90 38Q93 44 90 50M95 42Q98 47 95 52"></path></g>

<g class="fx-stink" transform="translate(0 {{a.mo}})"><path class="a wf stink" d="M84 74C87 70 81 66 84 62C87 58 81 54 84 50"></path><path class="a wf stink" d="M92 70C95 66 89 62 92 58C95 54 89 50 92 46"></path><path class="a wf stink" d="M76 78C79 74 73 70 76 66C79 62 73 58 76 54"></path></g>
